speaker: pujari
text: Follow the road to our temple.

speaker: meera
text: Follow the road towards the temple.

speaker: pujari
text: Please, meet me by the steps.

speaker: meera
text: The priest waits by the steps.

speaker: pujari
text: Ask around the bazaar.

speaker: meera
text: Follow the man with the bell.

speaker: pujari
text: Look closely around the broken storeroom.

speaker: meera
text: The storeroom may hold more clues.

speaker: pujari
text: The old vaults lie behind us.

speaker: meera
text: Try the vaults behind the temple.

speaker: pujari
text: Follow the marks by the stepwell.

speaker: meera
text: They went towards the old well.

speaker: pujari
text: Study the symbols on the wall.

speaker: meera
text: The light may reveal the way.

speaker: pujari
text: Follow the north road carefully.

speaker: meera
text: Your jeep waits on the north road.

speaker: pujari
text: You brought our memories home.

speaker: meera
text: Bring the treasures back to Ananda.

speaker: pujari
text: Thank you for protecting our heritage.

speaker: meera
text: Our village will remember your help.
